# agentgateway_mcp_settings (Resource)

Manages the agentgateway MCP settings singleton (`mcp.settings`, id `default`). Fields the gateway config file owns are rejected with a diagnostic; the gateway must use `config.storage.mode = hybrid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The MCP settings singleton. The id is always `default`, so there is exactly
# one of these per gateway. It needs config.storage.mode = hybrid, because a
# file-mode gateway cannot read the overlay back.
resource "agentgateway_mcp_settings" "default" {
  gateways = ["default", "mcp/listener"]

  # How sessions and tool names behave when several targets are multiplexed.
  # prefix_mode is one of `always`, `conditional` (the gateway default) or
  # `never`; `never` requires tool names to be unique across targets.
  stateful_mode  = "stateless"
  prefix_mode    = "always"
  failure_mode   = "failClosed"
  sse_keep_alive = "30s"

  # Reject requests whose Host/Origin headers are not localhost. Leave this
  # unset to keep the gateway default.
  dns_rebinding_protection = true

  # The serverInfo and preamble clients see when the gateway multiplexes
  # targets. `name` and `version` must be set together.
  server = {
    name         = "agentgateway"
    version      = "1.7.0"
    title        = "Agent gateway"
    instructions = "Prefer the target-specific tools when they are available."
  }
}

# The deprecated alternative binds MCP traffic to a dedicated port. Prefer
# `gateways`; the gateway does not expect both forms at once:
#
# resource "agentgateway_mcp_settings" "default" {
#   port        = 3000
#   prefix_mode = "conditional"
# }
#
# A field the gateway config file also sets is file-owned. Writing a different
# value fails with a diagnostic that says the config file owns the field; remove
# it from the file and restart the gateway to manage it with Terraform.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dns_rebinding_protection` (Boolean) When true, MCP requests are rejected unless the Host and Origin headers are localhost. Off by default server-side; a value the gateway returns is stored, and removing the attribute keeps the current value.
- `failure_mode` (String) Behaviour when a target fails to initialize or fails during fanout: `failClosed` or `failOpen`.
- `gateways` (List of String) Gateways that serve the MCP routes, as `<gateway>` or `<gateway>/<listener>`. Defaults to the gateway named `default` server-side. A non-empty list conflicts with `port`; an empty list does not.
- `port` (Number) Port that serves the MCP routes. Deprecated upstream; use `gateways` instead. Conflicts with a non-empty `gateways` list.
- `prefix_mode` (String) How to namespace tool names when multiplexing: `always` prefixes with the target name, `conditional` only when there is more than one target, `never` leaves names unprefixed (they must then be unique). Defaults to `conditional` server-side.
- `server` (Attributes) Overrides for the MCP `serverInfo` and gateway instructions reported to clients when multiplexing multiple targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server))
- `sse_keep_alive` (String) Interval at which SSE keep-alive comments are sent on long-lived MCP streams, as a positive Go duration such as `30s` or `1m30s`. Disabled when unset.
- `stateful_mode` (String) Whether to keep a persistent MCP session across requests (`stateful`) or create one per request (`stateless`). Defaults to `stateless` server-side. A value the gateway returns is stored; removing the attribute from the configuration keeps the current value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Settings id, always `default`.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the settings overlay.

<a id="nestedatt--server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server`

Optional:

- `instructions` (String) Overrides the gateway preamble prepended to merged upstream instructions.
- `name` (String) Overrides `serverInfo.name`. Must be set together with `version`.
- `title` (String) Overrides `serverInfo.title`.
- `version` (String) Overrides `serverInfo.version`. Must be set together with `name`.
